bak.title: Backup / move machine
bak.hint: Backup = everything in one ZIP for moving machines · your filled work is already saved automatically
bak.restoreMergeAsk:
Restore from ZIP by merging with existing files?

OK = merge (do not overwrite existing)
Cancel = choose another mode
bak.restoreReplaceAsk:
Use replace mode?
This clears the user’s uploads / templates / output / sheets / forms and autofill book, then extracts from the ZIP

edit.hint1: Click exactly on the dotted line at the start of a blank → text sits on the pin (pin = text baseline)
edit.hint2: 🎯 Fine-tune: select a pin (blue) then arrow keys ↑↓←→ move 0.5pt · Shift+arrow = 5pt · Esc = deselect
edit.hint3: Click a field name to select, then click a new spot on the page to move it · ✕ = delete

fill.hint1: ✏️ Edit values three ways: type in this table · click a red pin on the page · or answer in chat · values autosave as a sheet · ✕ = clear that field
fill.chatPlaceholder: Type an answer and press Enter…
fill.hint2: Type - to leave blank · edit [field name] or แก้ [ชื่อ] to change a value

chat.done: All fields done ✅ Click "Create PDF", or type edit [field] / แก้ [ชื่อ] to change a value
chat.noMarks: No marked fields yet — go back to tab ① first
chat.notFound: Field "{q}" not found — type part of the name, or edit in the table / click a pin on the page
